title: Sonic 3 & Knuckles
platform_group: Xbox, Xbox 360 e SEGA (Dreamcast, Mega Drive, Arcade)

projects.name: Sonic 3 A.I.R. (Oxygen Engine)
projects.description: Remasterização nativa na Oxygen Engine (C++/SDL2/OpenGL + Lemonscript) com widescreen 16:9, 60 FPS suaves, trilha remasterizada opcional, Ghost Sync, amplo suporte a mods (até 4 jogadores) e shaders.
projects.requirements: ROM original de Sonic & Knuckles + Sonic 3 (ex.: Steam). Sem compilação manual.
